blocks.text: Jared's take on City of Langley
People often mix them up, but the City of Langley is its own small city of about 10 square kilometres, separate from the Township around it. Its walkable downtown is the big draw.
These are the 8 closest neighbourhoods we cover to the centre point we use for City of Langley in Langley, nearest first. Distances are straight-line between centre points, so the drive is longer.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in City of Langley?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in City of Langley?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in City of Langley?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
